propositions: Over-triggering SHA-drift invalidation falls back to ANY code-SHA change when file_impact is undeclared, causing 21% of re-reviews on byte-identical material; the fail-safe must be scoped to the review's actual read-set and blast-radius paths.

The read-set is normalized from usage_log.run_shape's distinct_fetches by filtering to read_file tools, resolving paths to the hash root, dropping non-existent and outside-repo files, deduplicating, and recording in the signed manifest as sorted read-path lines.

Scoped SHA-drift invalidation applies ONLY when the pre-existing dependency set is empty, the container is not poisoned, the ticket scope is undeclared (not authenticated none), and a read-set was recorded; it then composes read-set with blast-radius entries using ADR-0002 machinery.

Blast-radius globs (criteria_routing.json, rebar.toml, criteria/**, reviewers/**, gates/**) are expanded at attestation time into per-file deps and a membership digest capturing addition/deletion; a single helper read_set.hash_dep_entry dispatches on metacharacters to route both through the same re-hash check.

Unverifiable read-set, pre-change attestations lacking the field, and expansion failures each fall back to invalidate-on-any-change; currency-basis in the manifest records which mechanism was applied (file_impact | read-set | fail-safe).
